relations.evidence: lakṣmaṇa śrīdharanāmdeukara (Marathi given name + father's name + surname)

notes: The catalogue gives the scribe as 'Dhananārāṃdeukara'. The colophon as quoted reads 'hastākṣara lakṣmaṇa śrīdharanāmdeukara'. This is a Marathi-style name: given name Lakṣmaṇa, father Śrīdhara (taken as father by convention, not stated outright), surname Nāmdeukara (perhaps Nāmdeukar/Nāndgāvkar). The place 'naṃdagāva' is a Nandgaon, most likely in Maharashtra, but several places have this name, so it is left unnormalized. This is a manuscript copied in Western India, not Nepal. The weekday matches: 10 Dec 1867 was a Tuesday (bhauma).
